summary_en: 100,000 shares (0.18% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥2,229/share for total ¥222.9M on 2026-08-28. Trading window limited to 08:45 JST execution slot. Results to be disclosed same day post-market.
title_en: Notice Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Exchange Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Mitsuuroko Group Holdings filed a notice on 2026-08-27 of a single-day treasury share acquisition program authorized by the Board of Directors under Companies Act Article 459(1). The program will acquire up to 100,000 ordinary shares (0.18% of outstanding shares excluding treasury) for a maximum total of ¥222.9M via ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading. The purchase order will be placed at the opening of the 08:45 JST single trading slot on 2026-08-28, at the prior day's closing price of ¥2,229/share. Execution is contingent on receipt of matching sell orders; partial or full non-execution is possible due to market conditions. Results will be disclosed immediately after the trading window closes. The stated rationale is to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business circumstances.
